G0010.name: Abiud
G0010.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G0010.brief: Son of Zerubbabel, ancestor of Jesus
G0010.short: Abiud was the son of Zerubbabel and is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in the Gospel of Matthew.

G0078.name: Addi
G0078.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G0078.short: Addi was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy in the Gospel of Luke.

G0013.name: Agabus
G0013.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0013.brief: Prophet who predicted famine and Paul's arrest
G0013.short: Agabus, a prophet, foretold a famine and Paul's arrest in Jerusalem.

G0067.name: Agrippa
G0067.desc: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
G0067.brief: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea
G0067.short: Tetrarch Agrippa heard Paul's defense and found no grounds for his imprisonment.

G0000.name: Unnamed#1
G0000.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G0000.brief: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
G0000.short: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

G0009.name: Abilene
G0009.brief: A region ruled by Lysanias when John began preaching.
G0009.short: Abilene, a region north of Damascus, ruled by the tetrarch Lysanias.

G0098.name: Adramyttium
G0098.brief: A seaport in Asia Minor, visited by Paul.
G0098.short: Adramyttium, a port city in Asia Minor, where Paul boarded a ship.

G0099.name: Adriatic Sea
G0099.brief: The sea where Paul's ship drifted during a storm.
G0099.short: The Adriatic Sea, where Paul's ship was driven by a storm on his journey to Rome.

G0001G.name: Alpha
G0001G.brief: A title of Jesus, signifying His eternal nature
G0001G.short: In <ref="Revelation 1:8, 21:6; 22:13">Revelation 1:8, 21:6; 22:13</ref>, Jesus is referred to as "the Alpha and the Omega," a title that emphasizes His eternal nature and His role as the beginning and the end of all things.
